Which booking site listed the lowest prices for St. Simons Island hotels?

Taxes and fees at St. Simons Island hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($30 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 16% at The Westin Jekyll Island Beach Resort to 18% at Best Western Plus St. Simons. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
